title: Degree-zero extraction from the global dualizing comparison
statement: Given an isomorphism of the global integral dualizing Hom functor with the coefficient dual of the compact-support sections functor, its component at one constructible object yields the displayed degree-zero Hom equivalence from that object into the prescribed integral dualizing object.

source.place: Second proof paragraph; derived global-Hom comparison followed by degree-zero sections and the coefficient-point equivalence.

proof.text: Identify ordinary sections of a completed-coefficient module with Hom from its regular unit, using the actual final pro-etale object. Restriction of scalars and forgetting to abelian groups are exact; the right-derived composition and homology comparisons therefore identify H^0 of integralDualizingGlobalHom with the derived Hom group by lem-pur-rhom-global-sections.

Apply H^0 to the component at K of the supplied global comparison. Its module isomorphism gives a bijection from the preceding Hom group to H^0 of the coefficient derived dual of compact-support sections.

The chosen compact-support tower followed by the chosen derived limit is constructible, by the normalized integral-functor comparison in lem-weil-compact-support-representative-independence. The point unit is constructible by lem-weil-constant-coefficient-objects-constructible. The integral part of lem-weil-point-fibre-equivalence makes point sections fully faithful on these two objects. Exactness identifies right-derived point sections with termwise derived sections; the completed constant-section bijectivity calculation in lem-weil-point-sections-scalar-extension identifies the image of the point unit with the regular coefficient module in degree zero.

The regular coefficient module is projective. The single-degree projective Hom-to-homology equivalence, evaluation of a linear map at 1, the derived tensor-Hom adjunction, and the right unitor identify H^0 of the coefficient dual with maps from compact-support sections to the coefficient unit. Transport both endpoints through the point comparisons and full faithfulness from the previous step, then compose with the first two bijections.

proof_origin.place: Second proof paragraph: degree-zero global-Hom extraction, projective coefficient unit, and fully faithful coefficient-point sections.

from.place: Degree-zero extraction from the global mapping-limit comparison.
